transcript: This man walked out of a maximum security prison four times The guards held the door First dressed as a workman he tapped a police radio on the guard's window and walked out Second posing as a judge he phoned the jail and cut his own bail from900000 to45000 Third he colored his uniform green with markers The guards saw a doctor and opened the front door Fourth fake medical records convinced the prison he was dying They sent him to a hospice Then Texas got the news Steven Russell was dead He wasn't Posing as a doctor he'd checked himself out and declared himself dead The one mistake that caught him He couldn't stay away from the man he loved Texas gave him 144 years one hour a day outside his cell
